enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn Token Steward tips and thank-you messages on or off.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: 'inline' shows a tip beside the message box and never blocks. 'confirm' additionally holds severe mismatches once on send.

costFraming.title: Cost framing
costFraming.description: 'dollars' for usage-based billing; 'allowance' for seat-based plans, where a lighter model stretches usage limits rather than cutting the invoice.

baselineModel.title: Reference model
baselineModel.description: Model id savings are measured against, e.g. claude-opus-5-5.

baselineEffort.title: Reference effort
baselineEffort.description: low, medium, high, xhigh or max.

minSeverity.title: Tip threshold
minSeverity.description: 2 x model-tier gap + effort-level gap needed before a tip shows.

stopAfterConsecutiveIgnored.title: Back off after N ignored tips

thinkingOffEffort.title: Effort counted when extended thinking is off

thinkingOnEffort.title: Effort counted when extended thinking is on

selectors.title: DOM selector overrides
selectors.description: Hot-fix for claude.ai page changes without shipping a new version. Keys: composer, sendButton, stopButton, modelSelector, effortControl, assistantMessage, userMessage. Each value is a CSS selector string or list.

upgradeTips.title: Upgrade tips
upgradeTips.description: Also suggest moving up to Opus when complex, multi-step work runs on a light setup.

celebrations.title: Celebrations
celebrations.description: Confetti and a milestone message when someone's savings cross a milestone.
